selection_basis: Budget-controlled proxy evaluation using 3%, 5%, and 9% anomaly budgets. V3 full-baseline overlap is reported as a reference-only diagnostic and is not scored in the quantitative proxy ranking. No human-confirmed fault label is available, so this is not an accuracy/F1 evaluation.
recommended_use: Use the selected unsupervised ML method for candidate detection. Use the V3 baseline as the main explanatory and diagnostic reference, especially for variable-level causes and operating-state context.
